name: Center Street Grill (Logan) Egg & Cheese Breakfast Croissant or Grilled Turkey Melt
whyItWorks: Casual downtown Logan grill offering flaky butter croissants with scrambled eggs and cheese in the morning and simple grilled turkey or club sandwiches on sourdough at lunch.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Egg, Ham/Bacon & Swiss/Cheddar Breakfast Croissant or the Grilled Turkey Sandwich on sourdough without raw onions or tomatoes.
watchOuts: Skip deep-fried onion rings and heavy pastrami melts during flares
